"Star Rappy Twinkle Collection Trials":
"In this Trial, Star Rappy Twinkles will rapidly appear, and your objective is to collect as many as you can within the time limit.

Collecting a Star Rappy Twinkle gives you a large amount of Exploration Points, and increases your multiplier for points earned when defeating enemies."
"Collecting 3 Star Rappy Twinkles gives you a chance to earn even more Exploration Points. The amount you earn is randomly determined, so if you're lucky, you might get a lot!"
